description: Potential Geothermal Reservoirs in Hungary is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by map.hugeo.hu. This dataset contains layers showing the spatial distribution and/or depth of the horizon, below which thermal water of a certain temperature is likely to occur within the said sedimentary succession. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include OGRE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
